correctness.rationale: The n6 symplectic quotient is four-dimensional, its 15 nonzero pair classes are distinct and its dot product gives exactly the T6 neighborhoods as all 15 PG(3,2) hyperplane complements. These are precisely the dual matroid circuits, proving equality of closure operations for all subsets. The n3/n4 cases follow from uniform and dual partition circuits. Explicit n5/n7 witnesses and a uniform n≥8 double-star witness violate CL4 by the derived white-neighbor degree identity. All 32840 positive-case subset closures and the negative witness cases were checked with the exact packaged script.
